# Top-level operations

2 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### doctor

**Check toolchain**

Report tool versions, paths, SDK and KVM readiness, and next_steps: what is left to set up, in order. Without a virtual iOS device profile, its step names the next stage of the setup chain (next_stage) and carries the whole chain in order (stage, what, done true, false or null when only the person's files or a later check can tell, how, ask_first). With a profile, steps name only what stops the next start: a profile ios.virtual.status refuses, too little disk space, a failed last start, or apps the last start did not install.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

Takes no arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call doctor
```

### capabilities

**What this computer can do**

Summarise in one call what this computer can do right now, to plan before building or starting anything: Android builds, the Android emulator (with its AVDs), connected Android devices, iOS builds with xtool, connected iPhones and the virtual iPhone (configured, running, phase). Each has ready and missing, the names of what it lacks; doctor's next_steps say how to set them up. Runs doctor's tool checks, so it takes a few seconds. testing lists each UI testing feature (id, feature) and whether it works on android, virtual_iphone and iphone (supported, note).

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

Takes no arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call capabilities
```
